answer: Put every newcomer on a separate island first: new identities trade only within a small quarantined shard, with no transfers to the main economy until they graduate. Graduation needs a full epoch of distinct verified work plus an ember deposit that burns away while they wait, so idle stockpiled identities lose money. Trust grows like yarrow, slowly and only where it is planted, not transplanted wholesale. A Sybil farmer must pay the deposit and the full labour for each island identity, and cannot merge islands or move standing between them, so cost scales linearly with no bulk discount.
